description: This file defines API routes for managing recipe ratings, including listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting ratings for a mock user. It maintains in-memory data structures for ratings and recipes, and updates recipe aggregate ratings accordingly.

methods.name: _find_recipe
methods.description: Finds a recipe by ID from the RECIPES list.

methods.name: _recompute_recipe_aggregate
methods.description: Recalculates the average rating and count for a recipe based on all user ratings.

methods.name: list_ratings
methods.description: Returns all ratings for the mock user ID.

methods.name: get_rating
methods.description: Retrieves the rating of a specific recipe for the mock user.

methods.name: upsert_rating
methods.description: Creates or updates a user's rating for a recipe and updates recipe aggregates.

methods.name: delete_rating
methods.description: Deletes a user's rating for a recipe and updates recipe aggregates.
